title: Understanding and Detecting Hateful Content using Contrastive Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the prevalence and detection of Antisemitic and Islamophobic content by identifying toxic textual phrases via Google's Perspective API and manual annotations, and subsequently using OpenAI's CLIP model to compute cosine similarity between these hateful text phrases and images. The study also qualitatively evaluates intrinsic model biases by observing false positives, such as the CLIP model erroneously associating benign text about Muslims with images of terrorists.
